title: Surface electromyographic activation patterns and elbow joint motion during a pull-up, chin-up, or perfect-pullup™ rotational exercise
journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research
population: Adults performing pull-up and chin-up variations (surface EMG)

keyFinding.enGB: Surface EMG differed by grip: chin-ups emphasised biceps and pectoralis more than pronated pull-ups in the tested sample.
